title: Management & Restoration of Fire-Adapted Ecosystems
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Management & Restoration of Fire-Adapted Ecosystems COA
outcomes: Possess a framework of facts, skills, and understanding of the management and restoration of fire-adapted ecosystems to make informed decisions about their personal lives, career choices, and the communities in which they live.

Think critically about the world, solve problems using appropriate analytic skills, and be discerning about the quality of information to identify and examine real-world examples of concepts explored in coursework and their implications for the management and restoration of fire-adapted ecosystems.
Communicate effectively across levels and disciplines utilizing a variety of methods and mediums on the subject of the management and restoration of fire-adapted ecosystems.
Participate in a vibrant community and culture, understand others, value diversity, and encourage understanding in the subject of the management and restoration of fire-adapted ecosystems.
